div.div:
Source: Report3.docx.pdf, §4.2 (pages 1–4). UC-nn: original use case. SUP-nn-n: derived support / specialization.
Solid line: actor association. Dashed open arrow: «include» (base → required behavior), «extend» (optional behavior → base).
Solid hollow triangle: generalization (specialized → general). Gray source UC marked (context): no actor assignment implied.
Relationships are modeling interpretations of descriptions / business rules; sequential workflow steps remain separate.
